purpose: Non-admission discovery registry of potentially useful catastrophe-risk data sources.

entries.name: GESLA Version 3 Part 1
entries.provider: NERC EDS British Oceanographic Data Centre / GESLA
entries.temporal_scope: records from 1805 to 2021; most begin in the 1950s
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 4,527 high-frequency station records; at least hourly
entries.note: Fixed GESLA-3 Part 1 archive assembled from many upstream providers; preserve station-specific datum, timing, quality and coverage semantics, and do not combine it silently with the separately archived Part 2 rights scope.

entries.name: NOAA CO-OPS Water Level Data
entries.provider: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
entries.spatial_scope: United States and associated coastal and Great Lakes station network
entries.temporal_scope: station- and product-dependent historical observations to current updates
entries.resolution_or_granularity: product-dependent; 6-minute water_level and verified hourly_height among supported products
entries.note: Water-level retrieval semantics depend on station, product, datum, time zone, units and time window; water_level may be preliminary or verified while hourly_height is verified. Gauge height is not a pure storm-surge residual.
